data.one_liner: Provides compile-time constant data for world countries using sealed classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides data for world countries in the form of sealed classes. Offers compile-time, tree-shakable constants containing ISO 3166 codes, names, capitals, populations, phone codes, and translations for all countries.
use_when: You need comprehensive ISO-driven country data in a pure Dart application
You want tree-shakable and compile-time constant country information
avoid_when: You need Flutter-ready widgets for displaying countries (use world_countries instead)
You only need a simple dropdown of countries without detailed metadata
strengths: Complete ISO 3166 coverage for all countries
weaknesses: Does not include Flutter-ready widgets out of the box
Large static dataset increases code footprint
